book.name: Yoan
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Yesu lipek e xe xel betiyeing vaxend

Inye bouk paviy mata wei Pasova yo. Yesu woulek bei bouk lam en ingwei embei na veil tembuing me na wou Ma yo. Moxo lalei vind emaxow xe xel wei toundei lek tembuing o, me e lam gweimbeeng ne eno moxo lalei vind xel ghanaw veil.
De soukeing wei xel di ya eno Sandang toung kwa eivek Yudas Iskariot, Simon neu woy, bei e toung Yesu na eivek xel ba memend.
Yesu woulek bei ma toung lulul dalus la eivek e xe nikanzek xeinghembi, me ingwei Anutu wong e lam me ingwei tyek nox me na wou Anutu yo,
om moxo qandi lek veil yaeing, me kwax e xe teimb ding veil, de vex vetivek ti vivekwou xeikatu.
Kalekom moxo taw memiing lek dipekta ti de mouk sekweyexe e xe xel betiyeing vaxend, me vu xel vaxend nangya vetivek wei vex evivekwou xeikatu yo.
Moxo lam wou Simon Petele, e tiwei neil wou bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, inye wa being zipek a vaxang?”
Yesu neil elox bei, “Wa seng woulek vati wei a wong gweimbeeng ne, qe kalekom tyek wang boulek loxyus.”
Petele neil embei, “Ma, wa seng teyei bei sekweyexe a vaxang se teyei.” Yesu lewexe bei, “Wangwei a se sekweyexe wang, on a se xe wang.”
Woyom Simon Petele neil elox bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wangwei nambei nyon nei on wa se sekweyexe a vaxang venaxow qe a memang me a lung is ambei nyon!”
Yesu neil embei, “Tambiy wei lipek woy eno tyek zipek vaxa venaxow dom neing dalus wo vako. De xam ghe wo vako, ekom se xam on dalus.”
En Yesu woulek tambiy tiwei embei toung e na eivek xel ba memend o, omek ingwei neil embei xam dalus seng wo vako.
Ka moxo lipek xel vaxend ma, eno moxo byex e xe teimb ding lek de lox me la dei lek nimbeeng. Moxo teling wou xel, “Xam ghe woulek vati wei a wong wou xam ne?
Xam ghe mi taxe a ‘Putoung’ me ‘Tambiy Ngandoung,’ om inyon nimza, en inyei ay ambei nyon.
A ne xam xe Tambiy Ngandoung me Putoung, de a lipek xam vaxamim, om xam is ambei nyon xam a mi zipek ama vaxamim.
A talex kwa ne wou xam bei xam a mi bong ambei ingwei a wong wou xam ne.
A neil wou xam zonghek, xukxe ti se ghanaw e xe teiv, o nenyalesana se ghanaw tambiy wei wong e la yo.
Gweimbeeng xam ghe woulek lulti beimambei ne, om wangwei xam ghe bong lulti yon dalus on tyek xam a qou mata.
Yesu neil e la tax en tambiy wei tyek na neil e teyei yo
“A se neil xam dalus. A woulek xam wei a beyal o. Ekom tine embo neing lek ambei ingwei di yeip eivek xoulek o.

content.text: ‘Tambiy tiwei ya belet is ay eno tyek bo vaxaghelu zekna me bakei ay.’ Qapiya Lalo 41:9

content: “A neil inye natax wou xam gweimbeeng dom inye se ghei qandi, en kandek gyeik ingwei embei qandi on xam ghe bongis bei A maxow Tambiy Tiyon.
A neil wou xam zonghek, xelti embei qou eti yeiw wei a wong e lak on qou ay, me xelti embei qou ay on qou tambiy tiwei wong a lam o.”
Ka ingwei moxo neil tine, eno Yesu lalei wo maying, me neil embei, “A neil wou xam zonghek, xam venaxow ti tyek na neil a teyei me na toung a na eivek xel ba memend.”
Moxo xe xel betiyeing di yei ma kanzek en nambei xel se woulek bei neil eti.
De Yesu xe betiyeing tiwei lalei mi vind e eno di yeip pepeeng lek zek paviy e.
Simon Petele bimexe lu me neil wou betiyeing tiyon bei, “Teling wou e bei moxo neil eti.”
Om betiyeing tiyon li lu la paviy Yesu bambou de teling bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, inyon eti?”
Yesu lewexe bei, “Tambiy tiwei ambei toung belet danghei ti eivek louk me na bong wou eno tiyon inyon.” Woyom toung belet danghei ti eivek louk me wong wou Yudas Iskariot Simon neu.
Ka Yudas ya woy, Sandang la eivek e. De Yesu neil wou e, “Lul vati wei wa being bong, eno wang bong daing.”
Ekom xel wei toundei me ya eno ti se woulek bei nambei nya Yesu neil tiyon wou e.
En nambei Yudas mi yeiteyei qoupek wei malew o, om xel betiyeing valu embeik nge Yesu neil wou e bei e na bou lulul en mata wei bouk ngandoung, o bong lulul wou xel kanyo.
Lutika eno Yudas ya belet wei Yesu wong wou e yo, de moxo la myayaing. De inye bouk.
Yesu neil embei tyek Petele dax e vun
Yudas la veil woy, eno Yesu neil embei, “Gweimbeeng Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek bo lei ngandoung me Anutu tyek na qou lei ngandoung en Neu.
Wangwei Anutu na qou lei ngandoung en e, ond Anutu tyek bong lei ngandoung wou emaxow Neu Moux, me tyek bo lei ngandoung wou moxo lutika.
“A neungyeiw, tyek a toumendei is xam enden nayaka. De tyek xam ghe gwimexe ay, nambei ingwei a neil wou xel Yudayeiw o, om a neil wou xam gweimbeeng: Ingwei ambei na nei eno tyek xam seng nam.
“Ambei bong petieing vako wou xam: Xam laleimim e mi devind xel nge. Nambei ingwei a laleing vind xam o, om xam laleimim emi devind xel nge.
Nangya tine eno wangwei xam laleimim devind xel nge ond tyek xomaxoneing dalus boulek bei xam on a xe betiyeing.”
Simon Petele teling wou bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wa being na nya?” Yesu neil elox bei, “Ingwei ambei na nei eno tyek wa se betiwou gweimbeeng, qe tyek wa betiwou loxyus.”
Petele teling, “Tambiy Ngandoung, nambei nya tyek a se betiwou wang gweimbeeng? Tyek a saing a xe mapieing en wang.”
Woyom Yesu lewexe bei, “Neing, tyek wang teyei bei saing wa xe mapieing en ay? A neil wou wang zonghek, gyeik qouklex se ghei sesa vya, eno tyek wang dax a vun luyal!”
